title: resourceWork
responsibility: Scopes an asynchronous operation to validated shared resource admission and always closes its queue connection.

inputs.name: resourceWork.request
inputs.description: Requested priority, CPU cores, memory in MiB and public label to validate against available capacity.

inputs.name: resourceWork.action
inputs.description: Asynchronous work executed only after admission; receives the bounded resource context.

inputs.name: resourceWork.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

inputs.name: resourceWork.options
inputs.description: Optional telemetry dependencies, cancellation, queue timeout or waiting callback for the named operation.

outputs.name: resourceWork
outputs.description: Admitted operation result, with reservation and connection released after success or failure.
